verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions PostHog's group/account-level analytics capability (grouping events by company/organization rather than individual user) — only a passing mention of rolling out feature flags 'by group' (posthog-docs-6), which is about flag targeting, not account-level trends/funnels/retention analysis. Since this is a fair and applicable axis for a B2B product-analytics tool, absence of concrete evidence means 'none' rather than 'na'.
